$comment: Phase 8 Seam 3 Sub-stage 3 (2026-07-07) — data-class registry v1 append per Ruling 4 (Amendment G). Extends v0 with 4 new rule-change event classes. Single registry, Sub-stage 2 pattern. Append-only. Retirement: never.
spec_anchor: Stage A §6 (Sub-stage 3 deliverables) + rulings §11.2 Ruling 4 (data_class_registry v0→v1, rule-change classes appended). Vestigial-by-ruling per Ruling 1(i): governance-event ledger rows use artifact_type='objective_request' (Sub-stage 2 precedent) — honest event class lives at stamp_audit.data_class.
amendment_provenance: Landed at Sub-stage 3 (2026-07-07) atomic commit per Ruling 5.

valid_data_classes.description: Authorized deletion event emitted by services/retention/authorized_deletion.py::execute_authorized_deletion. Ledger shape: stage='converge' + decision='continue' + reason=f'authorized_deletion:{held_class}' + stamp_audit={data_class:'authorized_deletion', held_class, keys_deleted:int, retention_rule_ref:'retention.vN', actor}. Held-class enumeration comes from services/compliance/held_class_registry.HELD_CLASSES (ledger_row, wizard_transcript, delivered_artifact).
valid_data_classes.spec_anchor: Stage A §5 (Sub-stage 2 deliverables) + §7.3.C (converge-continue neutral placeholder for non-refusal semantics).

valid_data_classes.description: Fallback bucket per R-3 discipline (mirrors refusal_families.v0.json::unclassified). Renders honestly on compliance surfaces; never silence. If any non-refusal governance event lands without a registered data_class, it MUST fall to this bucket rather than fail-silent. R-3 anti-silence discipline: unclassified is registered and renderable.
valid_data_classes.spec_anchor: Rulings record §10 R-3 (unclassified is a registered, renderable family) + Stage A §5.1 governance-event fallback semantics.

valid_data_classes.description: Dual-control rule-change event emitted by services/checker/countersign_ledger.py::emit_countersign_ledger_row when a pending_counter_sign request transitions to effective via CK-G1. stamp_audit sidecar pinned keys: {data_class, rule_class, consequence_class, initiator_role, initiator_id, checker_role, checker_id, initiated_at, countersigned_at, request_id}. Ruling 2: initiator_role and checker_role are CAPACITY roles (endpoint-required at time of transition), not identity primary/bracket roles.
valid_data_classes.spec_anchor: Stage A §6.1 CK-B1 dual-identity + rulings §11.2 Ruling 2 (capacity-role rendering) + §7.1.γ.1 sidecar+pinned-key+LB-gate pattern (E1.γ precedent).

valid_data_classes.description: Unilateral tightening becomes effective at delay expiry, emitted by services/checker/countersign_ledger.py::emit_tightening_effective_row. stamp_audit sidecar pinned keys: {data_class, rule_class, consequence_class, initiator_role, initiator_id, initiated_at, effective_at, request_id, effective_delay_seconds}. Per Ruling 3: emits UNCONDITIONALLY at delay expiry even if an active objection exists; only suspend() halts.
valid_data_classes.spec_anchor: Stage A §6.1 tightening-effective state machine + rulings §11.2 Ruling 3 (object() never halts; tightening proceeds unconditionally).

valid_data_classes.description: Objection annotation event emitted by services/checker/countersign_ledger.py::emit_tightening_objected_row when a countersigner (or admin) objects to an in-flight tightening. Per Ruling 3: annotates + escalates to Owner; does NOT halt the tightening. stamp_audit sidecar pinned keys: {data_class, rule_class, consequence_class, objector_role, objector_id, objection_reason, owner_escalated:true, tightening_request_id, objected_at, underlying_state}. `underlying_state` records the state the tightening was in when objected (should be pending_delay); the tightening continues in that state.
valid_data_classes.spec_anchor: Stage A §6.1 tightening_objected + rulings §11.2 Ruling 3 (annotate + escalate, NEVER halt).

valid_data_classes.description: Owner-suspend action event emitted by services/checker/countersign_ledger.py::emit_owner_suspended_row when master_admin invokes POST /api/master_admin/tightening/suspend. The ONLY action that halts a tightening (Ruling 3). stamp_audit sidecar pinned keys: {data_class, rule_class, consequence_class, suspended_by_id, suspended_by_role, reason, request_id, suspended_at, prior_state}. Suspended state is terminal — no auto-transition to effective; re-initiate is a new change.
valid_data_classes.spec_anchor: Stage A §6 (owner-suspend endpoint) + rulings §11.2 Ruling 3 (suspend() is a distinct, ledgered action).
